projects.name: distributed-sap-cloud-integration
projects.description: Failover and high-availability patterns for SAP Cloud Integration on SAP BTP, using Azure Front Door and Traffic Manager to route around maintenance windows and keep iFlows running through regional outages.

projects.name: az-private-linky-integration-suite
projects.description: SAP Integration Suite iFlows on SAP BTP that reach SAP S/4HANA over Azure Private Link Service, removing the need for a Cloud Connector while keeping traffic off the public internet.

projects.name: az-private-linky-cap
projects.description: A CAP backend on SAP BTP that consumes SAP S/4HANA over Azure Private Link Service, pairing with a companion Integration Suite iFlow for a Cloud-Connector-free architecture.

projects.name: ibm-eis-sap-btp
projects.description: Connects IBM Environmental Intelligence Suite weather data into SAP BTP — sharing a single EIS API key across business units through SAP Integration Suite and pushing weather alerts to apps via SAP Event Mesh.

projects.name: ci-cd-sap-cloud-integration
projects.description: A native CI/CD approach for SAP Cloud Integration on SAP BTP, using Groovy and chained CPI APIs to automate integration flow delivery without external pipeline tools.

projects.name: sci-rest-client
projects.description: A REST client for SAP Cloud Integration's Integration Content API on SAP BTP — handling URL construction, CSRF tokens, and artifact zipping to manage integration packages, iFlows, message mappings and value mappings.

projects.name: sap-cloud-integration-odata-api-v2-clients
projects.description: A TypeScript client library, generated with the SAP Cloud SDK, for consuming SAP Cloud Integration's OData v2 APIs on SAP BTP — cutting repetitive tsconfig and codegen boilerplate from integration projects.
